sonnet.problem: This card tells the king handing the Jews over to Haman ('These people are given to you to do with them as you please'), which leads straight into the decree to destroy them. The card ends on a yelling joke ('WHICH PEOPLE?!'), which is a joke inside a heavy moment. Papa Dorin already used his one 'this one hurts' line on card 8 of this stop, so he should show care here and not joke.
sonnet.rule: Heavy moments. A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke. He can show care instead, marked as his own ("I think this one hurts"). He can say once, simply, that a part is heavy.
